name: Butylamphetamine
summary: Butylamphetamine (code name PAL-90; also known as N-butylamphetamine or NBA) is a psychostimulant of the substituted amphetamine family which was never marketed.

uses.text: Butylamphetamine (code name PAL-90; also known as N-butylamphetamine or NBA) is a psychostimulant of the substituted amphetamine family which was never marketed. The pharmacokinetics of butylamphetamine have been studied in humans.

pharmacology.en: In the amphetamine family, lengthening the chain on the nitrogen usually weakens the stimulant effect and shifts activity towards serotonin. Its exact effects have mainly been measured in the laboratory.
pharmacology.zh: 在安非他命家族中，延長氮原子上的鏈通常會減弱興奮作用，並使活性轉向血清素。它的確切作用主要是在實驗室中測定的。
pharmacology.zhHans: 在安非他命家族中，延长氮原子上的链通常会减弱兴奋作用，并使活性转向血清素。它的确切作用主要是在实验室中测定的。

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed and has barely been studied in people. Stimulants of the amphetamine family can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，在人體中也幾乎沒有研究。安非他命家族的興奮劑可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，在人体中也几乎没有研究。安非他命家族的兴奋剂可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、失眠、焦虑与成瘾。

fact.en: Its code name PAL-90 comes from the Pharmacology and Analytical Laboratory where it was studied. It is amphetamine with a butyl chain on the nitrogen.
fact.zh: 它的代號 PAL-90 來自研究它的 Pharmacology and Analytical Laboratory。它是在安非他命的氮原子上接一條丁基鏈的產物。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号 PAL-90 来自研究它的 Pharmacology and Analytical Laboratory。它是在安非他命的氮原子上接一条丁基链的产物。
